row: Handcrafted Therapy is a massage therapy supply and training center.  This unique store also provides self care training and retail for massage lovers and non-massage therapists, too.  With a spa-like setting and classes that help you relax, Handcrafted Therapy is the ultimate in retail and training for self care.  These fun classes offer unique offerings such as couples massage classes, how to make your own products such as bath salts, how to relax/meditate, and self cupping classes.  Your unique formulas that you create in class (with the help of our experts) are saved for us in the future if you want to reorder or make them at home.

emails.context: info@handcraftedtherapy.com 2095 N. Collins Blvd., Ste. 201 Richardson, TX 75080
